label: TP
reason: Two separate vulnerabilities confirmed: (1) Insecure randomness - java.util.Random is used instead of SecureRandom for generating rememberMeKey (line 72-73), which is cryptographically weak; (2) XSS vulnerability - user-controlled cookie value flows through URL decode and directly into HTML response output without encoding (lines 111-116). Both alerts represent genuine security issues.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random instead of SecureRandom for token generation
Cookie value (user-controlled) concatenated directly into HTML response without encoding
